[Act: constitution
 Chapter: Finance, Property, Contracts and Suits
 Section: 271::Surcharge on certain duties and taxes for purposes of the Union
]


Notwithstanding anything in articles 269 and 270, Parliament may at any time increase any of the duties or taxes referred to in those articles 1[except the goods and services tax under article 246A,] by a surcharge for purposes of the Union and the whole proceeds of any such surcharge shall form part of the Consolidated Fund of India.
